source.files: Ref/06. COC BTLT ULT- BPTC DONG COC/ (33 individual PDFs + 00 ALL compilation)
source.extraction: pdftotext -layout, parsed by tools/extract_pile_specs.py; every record cross-checked against its PDF table row

common.note_L: Pile segment length L is NOT fixed on the drawings (drawing title PHC-...-L-...). L is a user input per BT00.
missing_from_drawings: GC bar grade - drawing gives d/N2/L2 only, no steel grade
Spiral steel grade - SWM-C (JIS G 3532) only, no strength value
Pile mass per metre - not on drawing; computed from geometry with gamma_c=25 kN/m3 (standard), to be confirmed by weighing/manufacturer data
L - calculation parameter, user input (range in length_range_m per pile)
common.status_rule: A check that needs a missing value must report 'chua du du lieu' (insufficient data). Do not fill in an optimistic default silently.

concrete_80MPa_cyl.Eb_source: TCVN 5574:2018 B80 Table 10 (EC2 C80/95 Ecm 42200 MPa, AASHTO 4800*sqrt(80)=42933 MPa)
concrete_80MPa_cyl.note: TCVN 5574 B80: Rb/Rbt la cuong do tinh toan theo he TCVN; khong tron voi fck/fctm Eurocode khi kiem tra.

pc_steel.sigma_pi_source: min(0,8*fpy, 0,7*fpu) — JIS A 5337 / Phu luc A TCVN 7888

materials_determined_by_standard.gamma_c_source: be tong cot thep, TCVN 5574 / Eurocode 2; be tong ly tam co the 25-26 — can can thuc te xac nhan
materials_determined_by_standard.length_m: Thong so tinh toan, nguoi dung chon; khoang dien hinh theo TCVN 7888 Bang 1 (ghi chu: chieu dai toi da co the lon hon bang, tuy thiet ke/thiet bi)

notes_on_published_Mcr_Mu: Mcr/Mu on Phan Vu drawings equal TCVN 7888 Table 1 minima for the same Do/class.

Phan Vu wall thickness t is thicker than TCVN Table 1 minimum t (e.g. D350: 65 vs 60 mm, D500: 90 vs 80 mm), so published Mcr is a standard minimum, not a recalculation for the thicker actual section.
Mu = kr*Mcr (kr 1.5/1.65/1.8/2.0) per TCVN 7888 §6.6 — matches published Mu within 0.3% for 33/33 piles; Mu is not an independent ultimate analysis.
Mcr back-check with sigma_ce nominal + fr=6.3 MPa: mean error +0.1%, mean |error| 2.2%, max 6.7% — consistent within rounding and the t difference above.
JIS forward loss calculation (sigma_bt=7.85 MPa) predicts Mcr 12-27% higher than published — do NOT use sigma_bt=7.85 MPa to back-calculate sigma_ce from published Mcr.
V cat (TCVN 7888 Bang 1) chi co cho cac cap tai liet ke trong bang; AB600 khong co V trong bang — de null, khong noi suy.
